Case 1 : Green manure (or organic fertilizer) vs. Unfertilized control. Useful to estimate the effect of organic fertilization. Can be relevant when no mineral fertilization is available (e.g., organic systems).
Case 2: Green manure (or organic fertilizer) vs Control with Y kg of mineral fertilization. Useful to evaluate green manure/organic fertilization as a substitution of mineral fertilization.

Case 3: Green manure (or organic fertilizer) + Y kg of mineral fertilizer vs Control with Y kg of mineral fertilization (same strategy of mineral fertilization in control and treatement). Useful to estimate the additional impact due to organic fertilization. Can be relevant to assess the impact of organic fertilization applied in addition to mineral fertilization, without reduction of mineral fertilization (sometimes done by farmers).

Case 4: Green manure (or organic fertilizer) + Y - X kg of mineral fertilizer vs. Control with Y kg of mineral fertilizer. Useful to estimate the effect of a substitution of X kg of mineral fertilizer by organic fertilizer. Can be relevant to assess the impact of a substitution strategy (X=Y corresponds to a 100% substitution).

Case 5: Green manure (or organic fertilizer) + Y - X kg (unknown) of mineral fertilizer vs. Control with Y kg of mineral fertilizer. Useful to estimate the effect of a substitution of X kg of mineral fertilizer by organic fertilizer. Can be relevant to assess the impact of a substitution strategy (X=Y corresponds to a 100% substitution).
